{{Top}}
[[File:CD2Harvester1-FF31.png|thumb|250px|A [[CD-2 Harvester]]]]
An '''agrirobot''', or '''agribot''', was commonly a simple, inexpensive droid, it was programmed to perform one function in the cycle of producing food. Among the available models were agrirobots that planted, sprayed, harvested, and packaged such edibles as fruit, vegetables, and grain. The [[Myrkr SS-23]], for example, sprayed various types of animal sewage fertilizer. Some models, such as [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[BigScoop Robo-Harvester]], could perform almost all these tasks. Other Agribots included the [[R0/5T.N1 tree feeder|5T Tree Feeder]], [[CD-2 Harvester]]s and the [[HD-234-C]].

Some general-purpose [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and throughout history, could perform farming and foraging tasks among others, such as: [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7]], [[Kaminoan droid]]s, [[OX9]], [[PKN-49 worker droid|PKN-49]] and [[R2-D5]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>
